claims.source_quote_ar: صِفَةٌ أُخْرَى لِقُرْآنٍ، أَوْ حَالٌ مِنَ الضَّمِيرِ فِي كِرِيمٍ، أَوْ خَبَرُ مُبْتَدَأٍ مَحْذُوفٍ
claims.claim_ar: قِيلَ فِي عِبَارَةِ «فِي ذَلِكَ» أَنَّهَا تَنْوَاعٌ أَيْ: صِفَةٌ أُخْرَى، أَوْ حَالٌ، أَوْ خَبَرُ مُبْتَدَأٍ مَحْذُوفٍ.
claims.claim_en: The phrase 'فِي ذَلِكَ' is variously analyzed: as an additional attribute (صفة) of something mentioned, or as a circumstantial adverbial (حال), or as the predicate (خبر) of an omitted subject (مبتدأ محذوف).
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited passage discusses the constructions for a prepositional phrase such as 'في كتاب'; mapping those options to 'في ذلك' in this specific verse is interpretive and should be checked against fuller commentary for this ayah.

claims.claim_ar: لَآيَاتٍ: وَاجِدٌ كَخَبَرٍ لِـ(إِنَّ) مَعَ امْكِانِيَّةِ أَن تَكُونَ (فِي ذَلِكَ) اِسْمًا لِـ(إِنَّ) وَأَنَّ لَآيَاتٍ هِيَ خَبَرُهَا.
claims.claim_en: The noun 'لآيات' can function as the predicate (خبر) — that is, the خبر of 'إنَّ' — while 'فِي ذَلِكَ' may serve as the اسم of 'إنَّ' (i.e., the nominal element governed by 'إنَّ').
claims.needs_review_reason: The source lists the possibility of the prepositional phrase being a خبر of an omitted subject; applying this to treat 'لآيات' specifically as خبر (and 'في ذلك' as اسم) in this verse requires cross-checking with extended commentary on this ayah.
